blocks.title: hormozi posted 9 times in 3 days. iman gadzhi, 12 times in 3 *years*

blocks.caption: both have millions of followers, so who's right?

blocks.text:
4,497 posts on his profile, and 9 of them between october 7 and 9.

short sentences, a face, a punchline. almost never a call to action.

only one of those 9 asked for a comment, "Comment dentist". it got 243 comments, about 1.7x his usual.

114 posts in total. his last 12 go from june 2023 to august 2026.

no daily tips, no carousels of advice. big announcements and moments of his life.

his bio does the selling: it points to his businesses, @consulting and @whop.

honestly, both of them, which is the annoying answer.

hormozi plays volume: so many posts that some of them always hit. iman plays rarity: every post feels like an event.

blocks.title: you're not hormozi, and you're not iman *either*

blocks.text: you don't have millions of followers. so **every single DM counts.**

lots of posts means lots of DMs, every single day.

the risk isn't a lack of leads. it's leads waiting two days for an answer while you film the next post.

few posts means few leads.

losing one of them to a slow reply hurts way more, because there's no new post tomorrow to make up for it.

comment your team below. i'm team "answer your DMs", which is way less catchy.
